clips.title: The story
paras: Solomon's Law is a local decree issued through Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall. It condemns the Shadowhide gnolls of Redridge to death for colluding with Morganth, an enemy of Stormwind. Adventurers are tasked with enforcing the town's harsh frontier justice by bringing back pendants taken from the gnolls.

Lakeshire stands largely isolated from Stormwind's immediate military support, forcing Magistrate Solomon and his town officials to govern Redridge with strict frontier authority. Operating out of the town hall, Bailiff Conacher serves as the arm of the local magistrate court. When external threats menace the township, the court has little recourse other than putting bounties on offenders' heads, relying on freelance mercenaries and traveling defenders to uphold the kingdom's statutes.

The legal justification for exterminating the Shadowhide clan rests on their alliance with Morganth, a rogue spellcaster entrenched in the eastern hills. Under the laws of Lakeshire and the Kingdom of Stormwind, directly aiding a declared enemy of the realm carries a mandatory sentence of death. Because the gnolls actively carry out Morganth's bidding, the court regards them not merely as wild scavengers, but as treasonous belligerents subject to execution.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.
Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.
These vile gnolls must be killed!
Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, friend. By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
